lines: Uuuhh... What the hell is this place... Why is there an abandoned school building in a place like this...?
That's weird... I'm sure I'm not going in the wrong direction...
And where is everyone... Leaving me behind is just cruuuuuuel...!
His face was completely soaked to the extent that it wasn't clear if it was from his tears, or his runny nose, or the rain.
Uuuh... Hebiko... Please notice, Hebiko... Please...
The only thing he could count on was Hebiko's radio.
If the electric waves he was sending out would reach Hebiko's radio, and if she would realize that the interference was his SOSー
I think it should be reaching you... I've sent out so many radio waves...
Shikanosuke noticed something strange. Normally, radio waves bounced off of buildings and walls.
He could see a large building. But this scenery and the sensation of the "bouncing radio waves"... somehow didn't match.
Eh!? Eh!? This abandoned school building is supposed to be here but somehow it's not!?
Shikanosuke sent out radio waves again.
What, is that all fake!? Ehh, maybe it's really fake!??
This abandoned school building... and everything else I can see...?
Shikanosuke closed his eyes and concentrated on the "bouncing radio waves."
It's completely different from what it looks like... This place is like a cave!? Am I being shown an illusion...!?
Uwaaahh!! I don't get it!! Hebikoooo!!! Fuuumaaa!!
Wh-What the hell is this place!?
As soon as Shikanosuke shouted, the scenery around him changed completely.
I'm not a ghost. I'm flesh and blood.
A woman was casually standing in front of him.
But even according to the "bouncing radio waves" she seemed to be a real person.
So you're not a ghost, I'm relieved... but also kind of noooot, it's still scaaaaary!!!!!
Who are you, I am not taastyyyy!!!!
Such a rude kid. But you're so cute I want to eat you♪
Aieeeee!! I definitely don't taste good!!! I'm constipated all the time!!!!
The woman smiled, caressed Shikanosuke's cheek, and whispered to him. Her voice was gentle, as if she were soothing a child.
You're a Taimanin. With a somewhat unusual Ninja Art... You seem to have seen through my illusion? And you are using that power to guide your friends...
At that moment, a voice called out to Shikanosuke.
As Shikanosuke peered into the darkness, he could barely make out Hebiko and the others coming out of the darkness of the cave.
This person...? But there's no one here?
When Shikanosuke turned around, the woman who should have been standing there had disappeared without a trace.
Shikanosuke shouted and collapsed to the ground.
Seems like he wasn't able to process all of this.
Oh, he's awake! Are you okay??
I'm glad you're safe! But what the hell happened?
S-Sakura-sensei!! I-I thought it wasn't a ghost, but when I turned around it was a ghost after all!!?
Apparently Sakura-sensei hadn't given up on ghosts yet.
J-Just now, at the abandoned school building...
Hebiko interrupted their conversation with her hand. Her sucker sensors seemed to have caught someone's presence.
From the depths of the cave emerged two men in Western clothing from another era.
They were dressed neatly, but the light in their eyes and their bat-like wings made it easy to tell that they were not human.
They were probably the male versions of the Succubi we had seen earlier, Incubi who lured women to steal their life force.
Don't say that like you're disappointed... There must be a reason for demons to be gathering around here.
Right, that's what we need to find out.
Sakura-sensei said and got into position.
Come on, Shikanosuke-chan, stand up!!! Let's fight!
